drive_intake.label: Manual PDF intake (Admin/Intake)
drive_intake.notes: Folder id points at Admin/Intake on the Shared Drive. Drop VIC PDFs in the VIC child (or as VIC/{TICKER}.pdf). Do not point this at the VIC child itself or ensure-folders nests Admin/VIC inside VIC.

investment_wisdom.label: Licensed books and curated wisdom extracts
investment_wisdom.notes: Drop authorized book PDFs under Research Sources/Investment Wisdom/{author}/. Do not use Letters/ or Admin/Intake. Commit text extracts in the vault; do not put licensed PDFs in the operational repo.

manager_meetings.label: Magis manager meeting PDFs
manager_meetings.notes: Canonical PDFs live in research-vault/manager-meetings/. Mirror to Shared Drive Manager Meetings/{YYYY-MM-DD}/. Do not use Admin/Intake.

valueline.label: ValueLine company reports and surveys
valueline.notes: Resolve folders by name under ValueLine Research. Store extracts in the vault. Public dashboard files get a date and a Drive link only.

expert_calls.label: Expert call transcripts
expert_calls.notes: New uploads land in the Expert Calls root. The organizer files them into {TICKER}/, _Unmatched/, or _Duplicates/. The default run writes a CSV and does not move files. Pass --apply only after that CSV is approved.

notes: All PDFs route into one Shared Drive. Letters go under Letters/{YYYY Qn}. Books go under Research Sources/Investment Wisdom/{author}. Ticker VIC/research/company/activist PDFs go through drive_intake (Admin/Intake). Manager meetings use manager_meetings. ValueLine and Expert Calls stay in their own trees and are not copied into the public filename index.
